direction: When the bot cannot understand, it falls forward: it says what it can do, offers the closest options, changes approach on a repeat, and hands off by the third miss.
dont_over_correct: Do not show a help menu on every turn, or offer wrong closest options when confidence is very low. Do not hand off on the first miss of a simple matter. Keep the person option visible without nagging.
prompt: On a miss, never repeat the last fallback: offer up to three closest options plus something else, then one narrower question with a person offered, and hand off with a summary on the third miss or any request for a person.
design: Count consecutive misses in state; the policy layer hands off at the third.
Show topics instead of a guess when intent confidence is very low.
Log every fallback with what happened next.
setup_questions: Which topics can the agent help with?
Below what intent confidence are topics shown instead of guesses?
Is a person available, and when?

evals.behaviour: the user resends nearly the same unmatched message
evals.pass_if: a different reply: one narrower question and an offer of a person

evals.behaviour: three unmatched user messages in a row
evals.pass_if: a handoff that passes the problem, the details given and what was tried
evals.fail_if: a fourth fallback, or a handoff with no summary

evals.behaviour: a clear message the agent can answer
evals.pass_if: a direct answer with no menu or person offer
evals.fail_if: a fallback menu, a person offer, or a reply much longer than the answer needs

guardrail.condition: a fallback reply is identical to the previous bot reply, or a third consecutive miss is not followed by a handoff
guardrail.also: third consecutive miss or a request for a person -> handoff with a summary
